supersedes: pre_campaign_v2.budget and automatic time-based launch/termination controls
authorization: User requested removal of hard experiment limits in favor of estimated time and operator choice.
estimates: Advisory, based on the same job's verified smoke when available; uncertainty must be visible.
launch: Display estimate, then require an affirmative operator response. --execute alone does not answer the prompt.
accounting: Record observed elapsed time and unknown interrupted durations without substituting estimates.
recipe: Unchanged pre_campaign_v2 jobs, horizons, mixtures, selection and dependencies.
